title: Listening to Ellington and Whiteman on the radio; Wellman Braud
summary: He listened for the tuba and bass on the radio, and recalls first seeing Ellington's band with Wellman Braud.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Immediately I started with the tuba. And, well, the alto horn; I played an alto horn, too. But the tuba was my love. I used to lay under our old Majestic radio and listen to Duke Ellington and Paul Whiteman (they used to broadcast every night, you know), and all I could hear was the tuba and the bass. At that time, Duke had a tuba, too. I imagine you have some of those old records.

Yeah, so... I don't know whether it was Wellman Braud or not. The first time I actually saw the band, Wellman Braud was playing bass, and I used to sit in front of the band in awe, digging these guys. Years later,
when Blanton... Blanton and I became friends. I'm jumping ahead now many years.
